description: G-5-188, on charge May 1949, first flight in Argentina 1 April 1949, collided with C-004 in 1963, retired 30 December 1970 with 1537 hours; gate guardian on a steel frame at the aero club. Photographed May 2022; one Derwent engine removed for restoration by EEST N°8 students under a December 2025 agreement.
aliases: Meteor F4; Meteor F Mk 4; C-088; C088
museum_name: Aero Club Chivilcoy Gloster Meteor Gate Guard
